verdict.rationale: Airweave is explicitly built to sync and index data from diverse sources (databases, cloud drives, SaaS tools, business apps) into searchable collections, not just chat transcripts — docs describe source connections to apps/databases and cross-source search, and community feedback confirms it ingests real data via RAG rather than being a chat-log tool. missing for 10: no explicit mention of raw file/JSON upload API distinct from connector sync, and no independent benchmark of document/JSON ingestion fidelity.
